injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——It is easier for you to first consider whether the problem is reasonable and then whether the relationship is comfortable.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Tolerance levels drop significantly when you feel unfair or ineffective.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your relationship load comes from having to maintain a façade.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This shows that your boundaries and judgment are clearly stronger than relationship compliance.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The key is to translate a clear position into audible expression, not to weaken judgment.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: - You are willing to cooperate, but less willing to sacrifice core judgment for the sake of the relationship.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: You will observe whether the other party is fair and reliable before deciding how much to invest.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your system doesn't like vague concessions or overly tactful packaging of issues.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This is closer to low-accommodation cooperation: able to cooperate, but needs reasons and boundaries.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The next step is to make the rejection specific so that the other party can only feel the attitude but not the standard.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: ——You can take care of relationships and retain your own judgment.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Your level of cooperation will vary with the quality of the object and the fairness of the interaction.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your relationship load comes primarily from delayed boundary expression, not from a lack of empathy.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: You are in the middle of the reference sample, more like a balanced collaboration than an unconditional concession.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The key for you is to make it clear earlier what you can talk about and what you can't continue to commit to.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: - It’s easier for you to understand others first and try to reduce relationship friction.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: You naturally pay attention to atmosphere, feel, and collaboration costs.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your burden may come from taking other people's difficulties onto yourself too early.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: You have been more cooperative in the reference sample, and your understanding and acceptance are obvious advantages.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The key is to bring your own needs into the discussion, rather than just optimizing the feelings of others.

injections.hero_summary.headline_extension: – It’s easy for you to prioritize relationships, feelings, and the overall atmosphere.
injections.domain_deep_dive.intensity_sentence: Conflict and disappointing others will occupy you more than most people.
injections.core_portrait.load_sentence: Your system is very good at taking over, and you also need to be clear about which responsibilities do not belong to you.
injections.norms_comparison.compare_sentence: This is a high agreeable placement, and relationship maintenance can easily become your default response.
injections.action_plan.urgency_sentence: The most important thing at this point is to practice gentle but clear rejection to protect the long-term quality of the collaboration.
